drafts.text:
Google updated its helpful content docs, and Cyrus Shepard's read on "effort" is a good one.

Effort is the proof of real work you can see on the page.

For a trades site that means:
Photos from your own jobs
The towns you actually serve
Answers you'd give a customer at the door
drafts.pattern: Riding CyrusShepard's 'Effort ≠ work' (Google helpful content docs update, ~10.9k views, 178 bookmarks) with a local-trades checklist
drafts.video_tip: Phone screen record, 8 seconds: scroll a sample trades site and pause on a real job photo section. Call it a sample.
drafts.best_time_ct: Weekday late morning to midday CT. Today's on-topic hits landed then: ridd_design's icon-set question 11:45 AM CT, jh3yy's blur demo 12:51 PM CT, CyrusShepard's Effort post 2:29 PM CT (Mon). The standing 8:54 AM slot still works for one post a day.
drafts.link_reply: Optional reply: 'I build trades sites around this: stableafdesigns.com'

drafts.text:
Web designers, what's the one thing you put on every local business homepage?

Mine is a phone number in the first screen that calls when you tap it.

drafts.video_tip: 8-second vertical screen record on your phone: open the sample plumber site, tap the phone number, and let the dialer pop up. No voiceover.

drafts.text:
Meta's AI, Muse, can search Instagram, Facebook and Threads posts when someone asks for local recs. That's from instructions researchers pulled from it, per Alex Groberman.

If you run a local shop, your Facebook page may now feed AI answers. Post your real jobs there too.

drafts.text:
Outlet or switch plate warm to the touch?

Turn off that breaker and unplug what's on it.

Heat usually means a loose connection or too much load on the circuit. Both can start a fire. Have a licensed electrician open it up before you use it again.
drafts.pattern: Question opener with a clear do-this-now answer (evergreen safety explainer, electric_4u style; electricians silent today)
drafts.video_tip: 5 seconds: a hand hovering near an outlet cover, then the breaker being switched off.
drafts.best_time_ct: No electrician-account timing again (electric_4u / Fat_Electrician / mikeroweworks silent). Homeowner tips: evenings or Saturday morning are a guess, not data.

drafts.text:
Putting up Halloween lights?

Plug outdoor decorations into a GFCI outlet. It's the one with Test and Reset buttons.
Use cords rated for outdoor use.
Keep plugs and connections off wet ground.

If the GFCI trips, it found a problem. Find the wet spot before you hit Reset.
drafts.pattern: Seasonal October safety tip with short do lines (pairs with the GFCI clip still on Tony's list)
drafts.video_tip: The GFCI clip: 6 seconds of her pressing Test, then Reset, on an outdoor outlet.
drafts.best_time_ct: No electrician-account timing again (electric_4u / Fat_Electrician / mikeroweworks silent). Homeowner tips: evenings or Saturday morning are a guess, not data.
